parsed.basis: Takamaka is a mostly residential and tourism-facing district on Mahé, south of Victoria, with no separate legal regime from Seychelles as a whole. Same-sex conduct is decriminalised, there is no trans-specific criminal offence, and the 2024 Penal Code amendment provides enhanced penalties for hate-motivated violent offences on grounds including gender identity. Constitutional protections against torture and discrimination apply, though gender identity is not expressly listed in the Constitution. No documented local pattern of police targeting, detention or institutional denial affecting transgender visitors is known for the district, and proximity to Victoria provides access to national police, courts and health services. Social attitudes are generally shaped by small-community and Christian conservatism, so visibility may draw curiosity or disapproval, but not documented threat.
